title: Finite local freeness of a quasi-coherent module descends along an fpqc covering
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a quasi-coherent module F on a scheme X and an fpqc covering whose pullbacks f_i^* F are finite locally free, the lemma concludes that F itself is finite locally free (statement lines 2221-2228). The proof displays the key equivalence -- a quasi-coherent sheaf is finite locally free exactly when it is of finite presentation and flat -- and then applies the two corresponding descent lemmas for flatness and for finite presentation of quasi-coherent modules (proof lines 2230-2237). The level is H2: the decomposition of the property into two descending ingredients is written out and each ingredient is matched to its lemma.
